Know what was checked

Included in this demo

Synthetic MCP configuration, configured servers, metadata-derived capabilities, and potential paths evaluated by the real Boppi engine.

Not checked

Your device, secret values, file contents, actual tool calls, installed package behavior, or whether an agent has been exploited. A clean sample is not proof of safety.

What configured, inferred, observed, and verified mean

Configured: present in a supported configuration file. Inferred: derived from metadata or the known server catalog, not a runtime handshake.

Observed: requires runtime evidence. This checkup does not observe tool calls. Verified: a subsequent supported rescan checked a specific predicted change, not that an entire device is safe. Demo changes are simulated, not verified on your machine.

Local by default. Evidence before action. Monitoring is an optional manual prototype, not active here.
